editorial_note: 35 actual sound sources with 45 preserved presets. Two owner-approved Water & Ocean Wave 2 independent CC0 600s MP3 preview-derived field masters promoted byte-identically: Bodetal Brook & Birds (distant stream with birds, not claimed as close-up bubbling), Crashing Ocean Waves (Wakanui breaking surf). Bamboo Water Fountain NEW-11 remains PLANNED/BLOCKED; no synthetic or unlicensed substitution. New detail pages noindex,follow; existing Ocean Waves URL and sitemap unchanged.

sounds.title: Light Rain
sounds.desc: Gentle CC0 field rain from a front porch; owner-approved 10-minute arrangement of 605 seconds of preview-derived source material. Soft passing outdoor sounds may be audible.

sounds.title: Rain on Tin Roof
sounds.desc: Rain drops on a real metal shed roof; owner-approved 10-minute source-derived MP3. Quiet average bed with higher transients; listen at low volume.

sounds.title: Distant Thunder
sounds.desc: Rural CC0 stereo field recording of distant thunder, arranged as a 10-minute master from roughly 145 seconds of independent source; events repeat.

sounds.title: Rain on Tent
sounds.desc: Rain pattering against tent fabric in an Altay Mountains field recording. A 10-minute master repeats approximately 125 seconds of independent source material; hear the textile surface and recurring pattern.

sounds.title: Rain on Car Roof
sounds.desc: Natural rain heard on a parked vehicle roof. The original mono recording is rendered as dual-mono MP3; about 231 seconds of independent rain recur within the 10-minute master.

sounds.title: Rolling Thunder
sounds.desc: Rolling thunder, wind and heavy rain from a real Baltic Sea storm. The 10-minute master uses approximately 605 seconds from a longer field recording; the 10-minute cycle repeats during continuous listening.

sounds.title: Rain on Leaves
sounds.desc: A real stereo field recording of gentle rain landing on foliage with soft wind and suburban ambience in Leipzig, Germany. The selected source contains approximately 605 seconds of independent recorded sound and plays as a ten-minute approved master.

sounds.title: Rain on Lake
sounds.desc: A natural stereo recording of rain hitting the surface of a small Ontario lake. The approved ten-minute master is assembled from roughly 343 seconds of independently recorded sound and repeats the source approximately twice.

sounds.title: Rushing River
sounds.desc: The real Magdalena River near Los Dinamos, south of Mexico City, was recorded in stereo by orlandorizo with a Zoom H5N. Strong continuous water rush rather than individual gentle drips. Owner-approved 600-second source-derived master from a 605-second unique section; the 10-minute master repeats only in longer listening sessions.

sounds.title: Gentle Forest Stream
sounds.desc: A real stereo field recording of the Jadwiżanka stream in Lądek-Zdrój, Poland, originally captured in September 2021. Natural flowing creek water changes irregularly across the soundstage. Owner-approved 600-second source-derived master from a 605-second unique section; the 10-minute master repeats only in longer listening sessions.

sounds.title: Gentle Ocean Waves
sounds.desc: A real stereo shoreline recording by Sandy-Ogilvie made with a Tascam DR-05x. Waves travel across the stereo field near distant coastal cliffs and occasional gulls are audible. Owner-approved 600-second source-derived master from a 605-second unique section; the 10-minute master repeats only in longer listening sessions.

sounds.title: Bodetal Brook & Birds
sounds.desc: An authentic stereo field recording from Bodetal, Harz/Thale, Germany. Recorded by Borgory using a Zoom H5, this source captures a distant flowing stream and birds, not an artificially generated or close-mic bubbling brook. The owner-approved ten-minute MP3 master selects approximately 605 seconds of independent recorded source; extended sessions repeat the ten-minute cycle.

sounds.title: Crashing Ocean Waves
sounds.desc: An authentic stereo coastal field recording of breaking waves at Wakanui Beach near Ashburton, New Zealand. The original 45-minute sound was captured by Desmond178 and released under CC0. The owner-approved ten-minute MP3 master selects approximately 605 seconds of independent recorded source; extended sessions repeat the ten-minute cycle.
